## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run lint`, `npm run typecheck`, `npm test`, and `npm run build` pass.
- [ ] `src/generated/` changed only through `npm run generate`, never by hand.
- [ ] New or changed behavior has tests, and user-facing changes have a CHANGELOG entry.
- [ ] Nothing in the code, tests, fixtures, or this description contains an API token, a secret,
      patient data, or PHI.
